name: Tecovasuchus
isnote: PBDB places it in Paratypothoracisini; the atlas parent is Typothoracinae.
sum: Tecovasuchus is an aetosaur known mainly from osteoderms from the Tecovas Formation of Texas.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: Catalogue number not given in the sources consulted.
material: Osteoderms from the Tecovas, Chinle and Bluewater Creek formations (10 PBDB occurrences).
biology: The sources consulted give no evidence of diet or habits.
author: Martz and Small 2006
